mapper.select: SELECT doc_id, title, current_revision_id, created_at, updated_at FROM wiki_document ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wiki_document (title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE wiki_document SET title = #{title}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
UPDATE wiki_document SET current_revision_id = #{revisionId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
